en_US: I’ve had enough of shopping for
a while.
I’ll grab a drink and unwind a bit.
I’ve shopped here loyally for years.
Now they consider me a regular! Ha!
Ah, young Pokémon Trainer...
As your senior in life, let me make
a gift of this Sticky Barb!
That Sticky Barb is a hold item.
If the Pokémon holding it is hit...
The Sticky Barb sticks to the foe
and inflicts damage!
Two buff guys standing side by side.
That’s all. What? What’s the problem?
B1F: Food & Produce
1F: Trainers’ Zone
2F: Battle Collection
3F: Stone Corner
4F: Poké Dolls & Goods
5F: Rooftop Plaza
It’s a Vending Machine.
Which drink would you like?
Clang!
A can of {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0} dropped
down.
Clang!
Bonus! Another can of {STRVAR_1 8, 0, 0}
dropped down.

messages.en_US: Decided not to buy a drink.

en_US: Well, well. You’re quite the adorable
Trainer. Ahaha!
I’m Bertha. An expert in Ground-type
Pokémon, and one of Sinnoh’s Elite Four.
It’s good to get out of the Pokémon
League for a spot of shopping every
now and then, though! Ahaha!
Are you aiming for the Pokémon League?
Then we may well have a battle between
us in the future.
I hope when the time comes, you can
show this old lady what you’ve learned!
You just keep on with your journey
for the moment, youngster.
But as a token of our meeting,
please take this Technical Machine.
That Technical Machine contains the
Ground-type move, Earthquake.
It’s an extremely powerful move that
can be used by a surprisingly large
amount of Pokémon in battle.
I’m sure you’ll get plenty of use
out of it. Ahaha!
Well then, this old lady must be going.
It was lovely to meet you.
